target_semantics_lesson: The target is the monthly change in the United States 5-year breakeven inflation rate.
evidence_selection_lesson: Validate growth and policy repricing agreement for baseline, futures and communication consistency for policy, and inflation measure agreement for persistence.
causal_reasoning_lesson: Economic growth can delay policy easing, supporting inflation compensation. Inflation persistence amplifies this. Cooling inflation acts as counterevidence.
counterevidence_lesson: Broad and sustained cooling in inflation can temper expectations, potentially exerting downward pressure on breakeven rates.
calibration_lesson: Compare breakevens with inflation data and policy expectations. Assess if cooling inflation outweighs growth-driven repricing.
